conflicts.axis: Data representation for duplicate audit findings (A15 resolution)

reviews.why: ATOM_012 proposes to 'Add ONE additive 'duplicate_count' (+ last_seen) field' to the root-rejection record as part of resolving the A15 collision. This directly conflicts with ATOM_005, which explicitly states 'no count/first_seen/last_seen fields expected' for the same duplicate rejection representation. ATOM_015 further reinforces the addition of these fields, creating a clear and fundamental disagreement on the desired data model for duplicate findings.
reviews.fix: A clear decision must be made regarding the inclusion of `duplicate_count` and `last_seen` fields in the duplicate rejection record. If these fields are to be included, ATOM_005 must be updated or rejected. If they are not to be included, ATOM_012 and ATOM_015 must be revised to remove the instruction to add these fields. A new, explicit refinement atom may be needed to document this resolution.
